description: This file defines the 'Termynal' class, a lightweight animated terminal widget using async/await, with methods for initializing, loading lines, animating typing and progress bars, and handling user interactions like restart and fast-forward.

classes.name: Termynal
classes.description: A class for creating and controlling an animated terminal widget with customizable options, including typing and progress animations, restart, and fast-forward controls.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Termynal widget with container and options, sets default parameters, and loads lines.

methods.name: loadLines
methods.description: Loads all line elements and appends control elements for finish and restart.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Prepares the container, clears existing content, and starts the animation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the animation sequence, rendering lines based on their data attributes.

methods.name: addRestart
methods.description: Appends the restart control to the container.

methods.name: addFinish
methods.description: Appends the finish control to the container.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Animates typing of a line character by character.

methods.name: _wait
methods.description: Helper for creating delays with Promise.

methods.name: lineDataToElements
methods.description: Converts line data objects into DOM line elements.

methods.name: _attributes
methods.description: Generates attribute string for line data objects.
